description: Territoires à Risque d’Inondation important (TRI BASSE-TERRE) - Enjeux STEU is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Data sets produced by the GIS Flooding Directive at a significant risk of flooding (TRI) of Guadeloupe and mapping for reporting purposes for the European Flood Directive. The European Directive 2007/60/EC of 23 October 2007 on the assessment and management of flood risks (OJ L 288, 06-11-2007, p. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Territories at significant flood risk (TRI BASSE-TERRE) — Issues STEU" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Directive inondation, Zones à risques naturelles, TRI. The listing shows 2020-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
